flasher.title: URTC Flasher Studio (CAN OTA)
flasher.subtitle: Golden-Image A/B Backup Slot Architecture • HMAC-SHA256 Signed OTA Updates
flasher.connect_prompt: Connect the USB-CAN adapter (top header) to query the real board.
flasher.no_version_yet: No version reported yet - click "Query Version".
flasher.trigger_label: Board is currently running the application (send enter-bootloader trigger first)
flasher.trigger_sub: Uncheck if the board is already sitting in its bootloader.
flasher.erase_label: Also erase the persistence F-RAM before flashing
flasher.erase_sub: Main board only (no F-RAM on the expansion slave). Only takes effect while the trigger above also runs (F-RAM erase requires the application still running).
flasher.downgrade_sub: Main board only. One-shot per attempt - only lifts the version-ordering check, the full image still transfers and is verified normally.
flasher.backup_button_title: Reads the main slot's current contents back over CAN before you overwrite it (bootloader must already be running)
flasher.connect_warning: Connect the USB-CAN adapter to enable flashing.
flasher.swd_notice: A browser has no API to drive an SWD/JTAG probe (Web Serial only talks to serial-framed devices like a USB-CAN adapter, not a debug probe's own protocol). This tab exists to explain the exact commands the desktop URTC Flasher tool runs locally via STM32CubeProgrammer/pyOCD - it will not execute anything from here.
flasher.swd_backup_label: Backup existing flash contents before programming
flasher.swd_dryrun_label: Dry run (print the commands, execute nothing)
flasher.config_freetool_sub: Only takes effect on a board with all 5 ID jumpers installed. Saved to non-volatile memory.
flasher.log_ready: Ready. Select a firmware image and click "START CAN-OTA UPDATE".
flasher.alert_connect_first: Please connect to the USB-CAN adapter first using the top header.
flasher.alert_downgrade_confirm: You are about to authorize a firmware DOWNGRADE, bypassing the bootloader's anti-rollback protection. Continue?
flasher.log_manifest_found: Manifest found: reporting declared version {{version}} to the bootloader.
flasher.log_manifest_mismatch: WARNING: manifest sha256 does not match the selected file (manifest={{manifest}}, actual={{actual}}). Continuing - the bootloader's own CRC32+HMAC check is the real gate.
flasher.status_reading_back: Reading back main slot over CAN...
flasher.status_readback_cancelled: Readback complete ({{bytes}} bytes) but the save dialog was cancelled.
flasher.log_readback_save_cancelled: Save dialog cancelled - data was not written to disk.
flasher.status_swd_not_possible: SWD/JTAG requires a local tool - not possible from a browser
flasher.log_swd_not_available: [Not available] Web Serial cannot drive an SWD/JTAG probe - there is no browser API for it, so this is a structural limitation, not a missing feature.
flasher.log_swd_use_desktop: Use the URTC Flasher desktop tool instead: it shells out to STM32CubeProgrammer or pyOCD to flash {{boot}} at 0x08000000 and {{app}} at 0x08008000.
flasher.log_could_not_read: ERROR: could not read firmware file: {{message}}
flasher.err_insecure_context: Web Crypto (crypto.subtle) is unavailable, so HMAC signing cannot run - this page must be served over HTTPS or from localhost. Current origin: {{origin}}
flasher.err_exceeds_app_slot: Firmware exceeds the {{max}} byte application slot
flasher.log_computing_crc: Computing CRC32 and HMAC-SHA256 over the selected image...
flasher.log_fram_erase_not_confirmed: F-RAM erase not confirmed within 2s (non-fatal, continuing).
flasher.err_bootloader_rejected: Bootloader rejected update start (expected RECEIVING status)
flasher.err_page_ack_timeout: Timeout waiting for page-ACK on page {{page}}
flasher.err_page_ack_mismatch: Page-ACK mismatch: expected page {{expected}}, board acked page {{actual}}
flasher.status_copying_backup: 4/5: Copying verified backup into main slot...
flasher.log_requery: No terminal status received - re-querying version to check for a silent success...
flasher.status_likely_succeeded: Update likely succeeded (board answers as application).
flasher.log_recovered: Recovered from a lost confirmation frame.
flasher.err_incomplete_no_answer: Update did not complete within 60s and the board is not answering as application
flasher.err_exceeds_slave_slot: Firmware exceeds the {{max}} byte slave application slot
flasher.err_slave_timeout_receiving: Timeout waiting for slave bootloader to report RECEIVING
flasher.status_slave_transferring: 2/5: Signature accepted. Transferring data (no page-ACK on this path)...
flasher.err_slave_generic: Slave bootloader reported a generic error
flasher.err_slave_incomplete: Slave update did not complete within 60s
flasher.err_readback_no_size: No readback size reply - bootloader may not implement 0x7FE, or nothing valid is installed
flasher.err_readback_no_firmware: Bootloader reports no valid firmware currently installed
flasher.err_readback_timeout_offset: Timeout waiting for readback data at offset {{offset}}

testerglobal.global_subtitle: Firmware-side override auto-reverts after 10s of silence - low stakes if it lapses, so this is a plain one-shot Send.
testerglobal.identity_subtitle: Written from URTC Flasher - read here for diagnostics.
testerglobal.erase_confirm: Erase F-RAM saved state? This wipes the board's persisted tool setpoints.
testerglobal.selftest_subtitle: Safe, at-rest values only (0-power/0-temp) - never actuates anything beyond a stopped state.
testerglobal.bus_subtitle: Every frame seen on the bus, Tx and Rx.

testertool.motion_subtitle: One-shot move, no telemetry, no comms watchdog.
testertool.vacuum_subtitle: Passively pushed by the firmware - no command to send.
testertool.drill_subtitle: One-shot send, no watchdog - the board holds the last value.
testertool.aoi_subtitle: Ring color comes from the global 0x100 command - this only sets mode/strobe.
testertool.laser_interlock_notice: Interlock must be armed for power to actually do anything (firmware-side gate).
testertool.scan_probe_subtitle: Max-priority ID - purely passive, no command to send.
testertool.electromagnet_subtitle: Latched digital command - no comms watchdog by design (see CANBUS.TXT note on 0x1B0).
testertool.weld_subtitle_gated: Requires the contact sensor to be satisfied (firmware-side gate).
testertool.uv_curing_subtitle: Shares TIM1_CH1 with the laser - same 250ms watchdog.
testertool.hotair_title: Hot Air Rework (0x1E0, telemetry shared with 0x135)
testertool.thermal_subtitle: 32x24 calibrated thermal image, pulled 48 chunks x 4 frames sequentially - no streaming mode.
testertool.no_handler_notice: No CAN handler for this tool - its actuator/sensor lives on the robot mainboard, not this board.

hooks.no_bus_response: No response from a URTC board at any known CAN bitrate (tried 500k, 250k, 125k, 1M, 100k, 50k, 20k, 10k, 800k). Check wiring and power.
